entries.why: The rule pack's own positive samples (String.fromCharCode over character codes) are what it detects; 0.6.0 shipped no obfuscation-shaped file, so the first release with them reports 'ships obfuscated code'. The rule-material ceiling is never applied inside a published package (fail-open audit, 2 Nov), so this is accepted here, by the project, for 0.7.0 only.
